2) Lead handling: 5 business days is fine, but we need a guaranteed secure transfer method (SFTP or Drive link with viewer-only + redaction of payment data). Also require a single consolidated CSV (fields: name, company, email, role, opt-in source).

4) On-site staffing & badges: we need two staff badges included for booth setup and two for the VIP dinner host table (total four). Please confirm badge counts and any limitations on staff-only access to greenroom.

5) Insurance & indemnity: our legal team expects at least $2M general liability with Harbor named as additional insured for the activation. If this deviates from your standard template, flag it now.

6) Sustainability: we appreciate the FSC requirement — also request a post-event sustainability report (materials used, recycling numbers) within 14 days.

Please respond with updated SOW language and an annotated DocuSign (or redline PDF) and we'll run it through procurement. Marissa, Aditya — looping you for any operational or sponsorship budget notes.
